about: docs/design/29 'Eval': the edit eval set. Each case is an interview (or a few) synthesized phrase by phrase with macOS `say`, so every line, filler, retake and pause has exact ground-truth times; a brief an editor would give; and the checks a reference cut passes. `k`: line (said and kept), filler (um/uh, removed when the brief asks), bad (a fluffed take the brief wants gone), pause (seconds of silence).

cases.brief: Tighten this interview: remove the ums and uhs and every pause longer than 1 second.

segments.t: Thanks for having me.
Um,
we started the climb before sunrise.
The pricing is simple: one ticket covers the whole valley.
Uh,
the lift is included, and the hut is open from June to September.
What I love most is the light on the peaks in the early morning.
And the trail is quiet before nine.

cases.brief: This interview drags. Take out every pause over 0.7 seconds, but keep every word she says, ums included.

segments.t: I grew up two valleys over.
My grandfather built the first hut up here in nineteen fifty.

he carried every beam up on his back.

cases.brief: Cut this down to about 18 seconds. You must keep the line about pricing and the closing line; drop whatever else you need to.

segments.t: Thanks for having me, it is a pleasure to be here.
I have worked in the valley for about twelve years now.
Before that I was a teacher in Bolzano.
The pricing is simple: one ticket covers the whole valley.
We also have a family pass, which is a little cheaper.
Most visitors come in August, which is the busiest month.
If you can, come in September instead.
Honestly, the light up here never gets old.
